title: Transfer Notice Timing and the First Chargeable Bed-Hold Night, Resident Funds Returns
content:
Where a transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account paid a bed-hold charge and the return of an overcharge is figured, the hold's first chargeable night is the latest of the charge's first night, **the first night the notice rule allows** and the private hold start date recorded on the reservation. The first night the notice rule allows follows the transfer notice recorded for the reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations:

| Transfer notice recorded for the reservation | First night the notice rule allows |
|---|---|
| the latest transfer notice was delivered after the departure date | that delivery date, because no day held before the transfer notice was delivered is ever charged |
| no transfer notice is recorded for the reservation | no night is allowed |
| otherwise (delivered on or before the departure date) | the departure date |

The departure date is the leave start date the reservation records.

## Both sides (hypothetical dates; departure 11 October, charge for 7 nights from 11 October)

| Latest transfer notice delivered | First night allowed | Nights the notice rule leaves chargeable |
|---|---|---|
| 11 October | 11 October | 7 |
| 13 October | 13 October | 5 |
| none recorded | none | 0, so the whole charge is excess |
